title: Mweya Unokosheswa Uyo Akabvunza Simba
intro: Munhoroondo dzeKorani, paigara munhu ane pfuma neruzivo zvakazozivikanwa. Mweya uyu wakabuda panyika nezvishongo nepfuma zvaishamisa vaiona, asi moyo yavo yakazvikudza nekudada. Tibatanei patinotsanangura chakavanzika cheimwe yenyaya dzinonyanya kunyevera dzeKorani, apo hukuru hwezvinhu hunosangana nemagumo anozvininipisa pasi pevhu rakavaberekera pfuma yavo.
clues: Ndakabuda muvhu ndakashongedzerwa nezvishongo zvaibata maziso evanhu vese.
Ndaiva nepfuma yakakura uye ruzivo rwakadzama rwaindisiyanisa nevamwe.
Pakauya mutumwa achidana vanhu kuna Allah, ndakabvunza nezvesimba ravo nekudada.
Avo vaiva pedyo neni vakazevezera kuti nyasha dzaAllah dzakanga dzisiri idzo dzakabva papfuma yangu.
Vanhu vangu vakashamiswa nehukuru hwangu uye vaishuvira mugumo wakafanana newangu.
Zvivako zvangu zvakanaka kwazvo zvakamedzwa zvese pasi sechirango chaMwari.

arabic: وَقَـٰرُونَ وَفِرْعَوْنَ وَهَـٰمَـٰنَ ۖ وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مُّوسَىٰ بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ سَـٰبِقِينَ
verse: And [We destroyed] Qārūn and Pharaoh and Hāmān. And Moses had already come to them with clear evidences, and they were arrogant in the land, but they were not outrunners [of Our punishment]. (29:39)
